result.stdout:
Usage: onecrypto sop <subcommand> [options] [arguments]

The Stateless OpenPGP command line (draft-dkg-openpgp-stateless-cli). Data goes
in on standard input and out on standard output; keys, certificates, signatures
and passwords are given as file names. Exit codes are the draft's.

Subcommands:
  version            print the tool's name and version
  list-profiles      list the profiles a subcommand accepts (generate-key,
                      encrypt)
  generate-key       make a secret key
  change-key-password change or remove the password of secret keys (stdin)
  revoke-key         make a revocation certificate for secret keys (stdin)
  extract-cert       turn secret keys (stdin) into certificates
  update-key         extend the validity and capabilities of secret keys (stdin)
  merge-certs        merge certificates (stdin) with the updates given as
                      arguments
  certify-userid     certify User IDs of certificates (stdin)
  validate-userid    check that CERTS carry a valid certification of USERID by
                      the authority certificates (stdin)
  sign               make detached signatures over stdin
  verify             check detached signatures over stdin; prints one line per
                      good signature
  encrypt            encrypt stdin to passwords and certificates
  decrypt            decrypt stdin
  inline-sign        sign stdin into one message
  inline-verify      check a signed message (stdin); prints the data
  inline-detach      split a signed message (stdin) into data and signatures
  armor              add ASCII armor to binary data (stdin)
  dearmor            remove ASCII armor from data (stdin)

`onecrypto sop <subcommand> --help` shows a subcommand's options.
